title: Record that the relay coefficient is the Gram boundary term
body:
## Summary
- For all 208 published flags, the channel addition replay ends with the Gram term `Q(inner(target root, source root), 2)`.
- Flag 0 uses roots `[0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, -2]` and `[1, -1, -1, -1, -1, 1, -1, -1]`. Their normalized inner product is 1, so the coefficient is 1/2.
- The side correction remains outside this replay, and there is no new exponent.
